'''Minos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] warrior who served under [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Sha'kel]]. After the [[Battle of Artorias]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] he was stationed on the [[slaveship]] [[Heart of Artorias|''Tsam P'ah'']] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
